func run(items: [Int], step: Step) async throws {
 let serial = inOrder
 // ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-swift
 try await serial(items, step)
 try await serial(items, step, reason: "Each update reads the previous write")
 var value: Value? = nil
 for item in items {
  if value == nil { value = try await load() }
  if values[item] == nil {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
   values[item] = try await load(item)
  }
 }
}
